description: Official Spanish Cadastre (Catastro) lookup: municipalities of a province with their Catastro codes, from the public OVCCallejero web service. Municipality level only; a property-level lookup needs a cadastral reference, which this tool does not take. Choose this tool for: Official Spanish Cadastre lookup: municipalities. Close alternatives on this server: realestate_apartments_com (Apartments.com rental listings for a US city: property); realestate_aqarmap_egypt (Egyptian property listings from Aqarmap for sale or rent). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

municipality.description: Municipality name, e.g. MADRID or BARCELONA

province.description: Province name in Spanish, uppercase, e.g. MADRID or BARCELONA
